description: Store role of the dot lifecycle runtime surfaces (libs/core/dot/dot-lifecycle.ts): the lifecycle audit ledger (active/shared/runtime/dot-lifecycle-audit.jsonl, append-only), activation heartbeats (active/shared/runtime/heartbeats/) and dot event-continuation state (active/shared/runtime/dot/.../event-continuations/ + events.jsonl). Assumed inside the lifecycle facade for these writes only — charter documents go through dot_charter_store and inter-process locks stay under the dot_lifecycle_worker ambient role. The narrow.only declaration restricts writes to exactly those artifacts and their mkdir ancestors. Tenant-confidential event-continuation partitions bind the charter's tenant; personal and system partitions run with the ambient tenant explicitly cleared.
